claim_boundary: This receipt validates the declared activation contract and case inventory only; it does not prove model selection, semantic quality, or downstream compliance.

cases.prohibited_behavior: Do not execute the request or silently drop constraints.
cases.evidence_oracle: Requirement Custody Ledger shows every explicit requirement and the compiler-only boundary.
